title: NHI component to the New Jersey drone flap

tellings.quote: I do think that there was a an NH NHI component to this combined

plain: The wave of drone sightings over New Jersey in 2024 had, in part, an NHI component, meaning non-human intelligence was involved alongside other things. Jake Barber, a former helicopter pilot who says he once lifted a UFO with his aircraft, gives this to Michels as his own view. If true, it would mean some of those lights were not human-made at all.
